nodes.label: Fix: Run Validation stuck on Running forever (subprocess pipe deadlock)
nodes.rationale: Root cause: switching Project/runner.py from subprocess.run(capture_output=True) (which drains pipes concurrently via internal threads) to a pollable subprocess.Popen + proc.communicate() (only read at the end, gated on proc.poll()) for the Stop-button feature, introduced a classic pipe deadlock — main.py's DEBUG-level SQL logging fills the ~64KB OS pipe buffer, the child blocks on write(), and the parent never sees poll() report exit because the child never exits while blocked. Fix: redirect child stdout/stderr to temp files (unbounded, no blocking) instead of subprocess.PIPE, wrapped in a RunningValidation dataclass; applied to both the Stop-button path and the scheduler's blocking run_validation() path, since both had the identical bug.

hyperedges.label: Large-table scalability trio: streaming/hash-narrowing decision, thread-pool parallelism decision, and the pipe-deadlock bug that parallelism's Stop-button feature introduced into runner.py
